title: God Rejoices Over You
story:
A young girl once returned home after a difficult day at school.

She felt sad and quiet.

Nothing had gone right.

As she entered her house, her father noticed her silence.

He gently asked,

“What happened?”

She didn’t want to talk.

Instead, she just sat beside him.

Her father didn’t rush her.

He simply stayed close.

After a while, she felt safe enough to speak.

Slowly, her sadness faded.

Just being in her father’s presence brought her peace.

In life, we often feel overwhelmed.

Troubled.

Anxious.

Unseen.

But God is not distant.

He is present.

He rejoices over His children.

He quiets fear.

And He brings peace through His love.
life_lesson: God is with you, rejoices over you, and brings peace to your heart.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for loving me so deeply.

Thank You that You rejoice over me.

When I feel anxious or alone, quiet my heart with Your peace.

Help me rest in Your presence today.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you feel anxious or overwhelmed right now?

How does it change you to know God rejoices over you?

Can you rest in His presence today instead of fear?
verse:
The Lord your God is with you,
the Mighty Warrior who saves.
He will take great delight in you;
in His love He will no longer rebuke you,
but will rejoice over you with singing.
